title: Chattree Plugin Manifest Schema v1
description: Formal schema for Chattree WebAssembly plugin manifests (plugin.json).

$schema.description: URI to this JSON schema for editor autocompletion and validation.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest specification format. Must be 1.

id.description: Globally unique reverse-domain identifier (e.g., com.example.my-plugin). Must contain at least one dot.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum Chattree app version required to execute this plugin.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the plugin.

description.description: Short explanation of the plugin functionality.

author.description: Name of the publisher or author.

authorEmail.description: Public contact email address of the publisher.

homepageUrl.description: Official project website or repository documentation URL.

primaryCommand.description: Default slash command without the leading slash (e.g. 'hello' for /hello).

type.description: Distribution category. Third-party community plugins must use 'imported'.

capabilities.description: Mandatory Host API capabilities required by the plugin.

optionalCapabilities.description: Capabilities requested on an opportunistic basis.

tags.description: Keywords for discovery in the marketplace.

changelog.description: Release notes for the current version.

entrypoint.description: Name of the exported WebAssembly function called by Chattree.

wasmPath.description: Relative filename of the WebAssembly binary in the package root. Must be 'plugin.wasm'.

wasmSha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hex digest of plugin.wasm (64 lowercase hex characters).

runtimeApiVersion.description: Version of the Chattree Host API contract. Must be '1.0.0'.

maxMemoryPages.description: Maximum memory limit in 64 KB WebAssembly pages (max 256 pages = 16 MB).

timeoutMs.description: Per-invocation execution timeout in milliseconds (max 60000 ms).

fuelLimit.description: Instruction fuel limit to prevent infinite loops.

tools.description: Declared tools and commands exposed to the user or conversational agent.

settings.description: Configurable parameters shown in the plugin settings UI.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool within the plugin.

command.description: Slash command trigger without leading slash.

displayName.description: Label displayed in chat suggestions and toolbar.

description.description: Explanation of tool usage and argument expectations.

capabilities.description: Sub-capabilities specifically required by this tool.

key.description: Key identifier used to read the setting via storage or config APIs.

label.description: Human-readable label rendered in settings UI.

description.description: Help text explaining the configuration setting.

isSecret.description: Mask input in the UI and store in device secure keystore if true.
